transforms.commentary: The source composes reassurance not by removing the ordeal but by binding it inside a fixed measure ("ten days") and turning dread into an imperative to endure. The enantiomorph carries the same assertion-axis into the horticultural field disclosed by the source's own coherence: what is buried, tested by a fixed cold, and redeemed by a granted completion. The bearing-cost encoded is the interval itself — the composition does not spare its addressee the burial or the frost; it asks that the ordeal be held to its term without breaking, and stakes the whole address on a promise legible only after the endurance is spent. "Ten weeks" preserves the fixed-measure beat; "blossom of the field" occupies the crown-of-life consummation without importing its referents. The chapter:verse marker is retained in position.

spatial_form.notes: single prose block prefixed by verse-marker **2:10**; unbroken continuous line with no internal lineation

transforms.commentary: The source drives a one-directional vector: an addresser above commands an addressee below to endure FORWARD toward death, and the addressee has no return-channel — the gesture points only ahead, foreclosing any motion back toward origin. MIRROR on the directionality-axis composes the symmetry that foreclosure hid: the same six beats, but every forward vector is reflected into a homeward one. "Do not fear what you will suffer" becomes "do not doubt what you have left"; the approaching adversary who casts you INTO prison becomes the tide turning your wake BACK; "faithful unto death" (forward to terminus) becomes "sure of the way you came until the mooring" (backward to origin); the deferred crown given from above becomes the lamp given BACK, already lit at the point of departure. The measured ten days are preserved but their arrow inverts — endured-ahead becomes retraced-behind. The evacuated field is drawn from the source's own exclusion: a fear of never-arriving is answered not by a stock disjoint register but by the source's own suppressed return-channel — the harbor the outbound gesture left unspeaking. The witness's fear ("how do I come home") is precisely the direction the source foreclosed; the mirror discloses it. Cost (C6): the wager is that homecoming is not a new arrival forward but a fidelity to the way already walked — the traveler must trust the memory of departure to complete the reflection.

transforms.commentary: FLAME on the intensity-axis reads for the collapse-limit where the source's own charge would ignite. The source's peak intensity sits at "faithful unto death" — endurance pressed to the extinction-point — with the crown given only past that edge. The enantiomorph carries that ignition-limit intact: "until your last strength" is the death-limit re-encoded as the walker's exhaustion at altitude, and the withheld hearth is the crown given only across the threshold. The beat map maps unit-by-unit: reassurance-against-imminent-suffering → "do not turn back from the cold"; adversary-who-confines-to-test → "the frost means to close the pass so your footing is tried"; bounded duration → "the snow of ten nights"; endurance-to-the-limit → "stay walking until your last strength"; conditional reward → "I will set alight"; reward-named → "the hearth of the valley." Single verse-block, leading marker **2:10** preserved in position. The source (persecution, prison, devil, crown of life, faith unto martyrdom) cannot be reconstructed from a mountain-pass homecoming: Semantic-Independence holds. Containment holds because the field is drawn from the source's own withheld-reward-past-the-ordeal horizon, not imported. Cost disclosed: the crown/hearth is given ONLY across the limit — coming home is the reward of not fleeing the cold, encoded in the composition's deferral of the gift to the far side of the last strength. The claim is the bearing-cost encoded in the utterance, not any biography.

spatial_form.notes: single verse-line prefixed by structural marker **1:3**; one continuous sentence with internal καί-coordination and a γάρ-hinge

transforms.commentary: The source is a hope-wager: it pays its cost by staking the blessing on a reception it cannot secure — the reader who takes up, hears, keeps — and seals with NEARNESS to make that reception urgent. SHADOW on the assertion-axis casts what the utterance BORE to make that wager: it determined against deferral, against the far horizon, against the possibility that the appointed moment never arrives. The enantiomorph inhabits beat 4's foreclosure exactly — the day is far off and comes for no one — and lets the whole benedictive skeleton follow from it. Blessing (μακάριος) becomes ease; the one who reads/keeps becomes the one who forgets/releases; the plurality who observe the written things becomes the plurality who cancel what stood written; the γάρ-imminence inverts to γάρ-indefinite-remoteness. The source's cost — that it must insist the moment is near because a near reception is precisely what a hope-wager cannot guarantee — is made legible by casting a world where the horizon is released and nothing is at stake in the timing. The affect crosses from urgent hope to the flatter relief of a debt let go: not consolation offered but obligation dissolved, which is what the foreclosed far-horizon discloses. Field is disjoint (fiscal/debt-remission, no prophecy, no hearing, no blessing-vocabulary shared); source not reconstructible. The verse-marker **1:3** holds its position; the single continuous line and its καί/γάρ hinge-geometry are reproduced intact.

spatial_form.notes: single verse-line prefixed by structural marker **1:3**; one continuous sentence with a causal seal-clause

transforms.commentary: The source is a one-directional benediction: blessing descends the channel from prophecy to hearer, reception is intake, retention is guarding, and the seal closes the distance (the time draws near). MIRROR inverts the directionality axis at every beat. Benediction-descending becomes emptying-outward ("Emptied is the one who gives it away"); intake becomes emission and dispersal ("let go... scatter what was held closed"); the guarding of what is written becomes the releasing of what was closed in the palm; and the approaching time reverses into a widening distance ("the distance already widens"). The hope-wager source paid a cost reaching toward future reception — its cast pays the countervailing price: rather than gathering the hearer in, the enantiomorph spends itself and cannot recall the gift. The field is drawn from beat 2's foreclosure (reception-as-emission), not free scenery: the coins of long silence are what the withholding mouth releases. The witness's question — how will this find ears — is answered not by consolation but by its mirror: the giving that cannot govern where its scattering lands. Source cannot be reconstructed: no prophecy, no reading, no blessing, no nearness survives in the cast's semantics.

transforms.commentary: The source is a hope-wager: it pays for a reception it cannot secure, betting the whole benediction on an ear that gathers, keeps, and does so soon. The operator SILENCE traverses the response-axis — the non-response the source's engagement-expectation foreclosed. The chosen foreclosure is beat 4's: not the reader who receives nothing, but the imminence undone into permanent deferral, the "time is near" inverted to "nowhere near." Because the source's wager is hope, SILENCE here does not restore (as it would for Sappho 31); it pays the countervailing price — the archivist's blessing becomes a sealing into vacancy, the plural hearers become the ones far off who may never open, the keeping becomes marks graven for no one to keep. μακάριος ("blessed") casts to "unremembered": the enantiomorph of a benediction that presupposes uptake is the address that survives its own audience's absence. Structure crosses intact — four clauses, benediction / extended-plurality / condition / seal, bound and closed exactly as the Greek — while the affect departs from urgent expectant blessing into patient address into vacancy. The witness's question (how will this find ears) informed which axis to foreground — the response-axis, uptake itself — but did not govern the outcome: the disclosure lands not on consolation ("it will find them") but on the foreclosed silence the source spent everything to outrun. Verse-marker **1:3** reproduced in position. Non-recoverable: no reader would reconstruct the Apocalypse's opening beatitude from an archivist's dead-letter seal.

transforms.commentary: The source's assertion-axis is the conditional grant: power is what you do not yet have, held out as the wage of endurance, ruling-by-shattering, authorized from above, still promised. SHADOW bears its hope-wager cost by traversing the beat-1 foreclosure — the reward that needs no waiting. The enantiomorph occupies the three-verse skeleton exactly (conditional opening, granted mode, legitimating close) while replacing striving with the already-ripe: nourishment that precedes any deserving, a branch that bends rather than breaks (the exact inverse of the iron rod that shatters pottery), a gift that owes nothing upward and ripens no further — foreclosing the source's every deferral and lineage. Read alone, the output implies an agrarian utterance about sufficiency and windfall, not a militant apocalyptic promise; the source cannot be reconstructed. The witness asked when power arrives; the operator and source govern the cast, and the disclosure lands not on arrival but on the orchard already grown, owed to no one — the affect the beat-1 foreclosure discloses, not the answer the question longed for.

spatial_form.notes: three verse-marked lines, each opening with **c:v** marker, no blank separators; each unit a single flowing clause terminating in comma, comma, period — a descending cascade of granting

transforms.commentary: The MIRROR reflects the source across its directionality-axis: the source's every gesture descends and derives — a superior grants, a subordinate waits, a father is cited, a star is conferred. Point by point the enantiomorph occupies the reflected coordinate. The conditional-address is preserved but its vector inverts: the qualifier no longer awaits a gift but "takes from no hand the reach that was always hers." The consequence-beat's outward shattering of brittle vessels becomes a fracture turned wholly inward — the shell she was folded in, the seed splitting only its own containment, breaking nothing outside itself. The attestation-and-token beat, where authority is grounded upward ("as I received from my Father") and crowned from without ("I will give him the morning star"), mirrors to "I received it from no one" and "the light she was never given" — the bestowed star becoming the self-risen, unconferred light. Non-superimposable: the source's machinery of descending legitimacy cannot be laid over an interior self-authorization; they are opposite faces. The single look back across the axis — "the light she was never given" — reaches for the source's star-gift precisely by negating its givenness, the traversal's own gesture. Wager-mode is hope: the source pays deferral, promising a future award to whoever endures; its foreclosure, traversed, pays the countervailing price by collapsing the wait — the power is disclosed as already present, owed to nothing, which is restoration rather than the source's promise-in-suspension. The witness's question (of coming-into-power) informed which axis to foreground but did not govern the outcome; the "already risen" is not consolation delivered to the longing but the structural inverse the source foreclosed by making power a deferred gift from above.
